title: Receipted delivery tests: the "reloaded" helper should read the saved SQLite row, not in-memory serialization
outcome: Receipted delivery tests: the "reloaded" helper should read the saved SQLite row, not in-memory serialization
acceptance: Every prompt-delivery test that asserts a durable or restart-time disposition reads it back from the saved store row (after the persist queue drains), not from in-memory serialization
A test shows such a read catches a settlement made without stamping the session
